ArchitectureMapRaw.description: Flat harness output for architecture mapper. All list[str], no nesting.

api_endpoints.description: One string per API endpoint. Format: 'method | path | handler | file_path:line | auth_required | rate_limited'. Example: 'GET | /api/users | get_users | src/api.py:15 | true | false'
api_endpoints.title: Api Endpoints

app_type.description: Application type: web_api, cli_tool, library, microservice, monolith
app_type.title: App Type

entry_points.description: One string per entry point. Format: 'kind | route_or_id | file_path:line | auth_required'. Example: 'http | POST /api/login | src/routes.py:42 | false'
entry_points.title: Entry Points

modules.description: One string per module. Format: 'name | path | language | description'. Example: 'auth | src/auth/ | python | Authentication and session management'
modules.title: Modules

services.description: One string per external service. Format: 'name | type | endpoint | auth_mechanism'. Example: 'PostgreSQL | database | localhost:5432 | password'
services.title: Services

trust_boundaries.description: One string per boundary. Format: 'name | source_zone | target_zone | description'. Example: 'API Gateway | external | internal | Rate limiting and auth'
trust_boundaries.title: Trust Boundaries

ArchitectureMapRaw.title: ArchitectureMapRaw

CWEExpansion.description: AI-suggested CWE additions based on recon context.

additional_cwes.description: CWE IDs to add beyond baseline, e.g. ['CWE-918', 'CWE-611'].
additional_cwes.title: Additional Cwes

CWEExpansion.title: CWEExpansion

ChainCorrelationResult.description: Flat harness schema for chain correlation. LLM identifies chains only.

chains.description: Multi-step attack chains found. Format per entry: 'title | finding_id1,finding_id2,... | combined_impact | severity'. Example: 'SSRF to Internal API | f1,f2 | Access internal services | high'
chains.title: Chains

duplicate_ids.description: Finding IDs that are duplicates missed by programmatic dedup (to drop)
duplicate_ids.title: Duplicate Ids

ChainCorrelationResult.title: ChainCorrelationResult

ConfigReportRaw.description: Flat harness output for config scanner. All list[str], no nesting.

misconfigs.description: One string per misconfiguration. Format: 'category | file_path:line | key | risk | remediation'. Example: 'debug_mode | config.py:15 | DEBUG=True | Exposes stack traces | Set DEBUG=False'
misconfigs.title: Misconfigs

secrets.description: One string per secret finding. Format: 'type | file_path:line | match_preview | confidence | is_test(true/false)'. Example: 'aws_access_key | .env:3 | AKIA... | high | false'
secrets.title: Secrets

ConfigReportRaw.title: ConfigReportRaw

CrossServiceFinding.description: Flat schema for cross-service attack chain analysis. 4 fields.

chain_description.description: Description of the cross-service attack path
chain_description.title: Chain Description

entry_point.description: Public-facing entry point where attack begins
entry_point.title: Entry Point

impact.description: Impact if the cross-service chain is exploited
impact.title: Impact

services_involved.description: Service names in the attack chain
services_involved.title: Services Involved

CrossServiceFinding.title: CrossServiceFinding

DastVerificationResult.description: Flat schema for DAST-like runtime verification. 4 fields.

exploit_confirmed.description: Whether the exploit was confirmed at runtime
exploit_confirmed.title: Exploit Confirmed

payload_sent.description: The exploit payload or request that was sent
payload_sent.title: Payload Sent

safety_notes.description: Safety measures taken during verification (sandbox, timeout, etc.)
safety_notes.title: Safety Notes

DastVerificationResult.title: DastVerificationResult

DataFlowMapRaw.description: Flat harness output for data flow mapper. All list[str], no nesting.

flows.description: One string per data flow. Format: 'source | sink | sanitized(true/false) | file1, file2, ...'. Example: 'request.body | sql.execute | false | src/db.py, src/routes.py'
flows.title: Flows

sanitization_points.description: One string per sanitization point. Format: 'file_path:line | function_name | type | protects_against'. Example: 'src/utils.py:42 | sanitize_html | html_encoding | CWE-79'
sanitization_points.title: Sanitization Points

sinks.description: One string per security-critical sink. Format: 'sink_type | file_path:line | function_name | notes'. Example: 'sql_execute | src/db.py:55 | run_query | Direct string concatenation'
sinks.title: Sinks

DataFlowMapRaw.title: DataFlowMapRaw

DataFlowTrace.description: Flat schema for data flow tracing sub-agent. 4 fields.

sink_reached.description: Whether tainted data actually reaches the sink
sink_reached.title: Sink Reached

steps.description: Ordered list of file:line descriptions showing flow path
steps.title: Steps

DataFlowTrace.title: DataFlowTrace

DependencyReportRaw.description: Flat harness output for dependency auditor. All list[str], no nesting.

known_cves.description: One string per CVE. Format: 'cve_id | package | installed_version | fixed_version | cvss_score | direct | reachable'. Example: 'CVE-2023-1234 | lodash | 4.17.15 | 4.17.21 | 7.5 | true | unknown'
known_cves.title: Known Cves

outdated.description: One string per outdated dep. Format: 'package | current_version | latest_version | direct(true/false)'. Example: 'express | 4.17.0 | 4.18.2 | true'
outdated.title: Outdated

sbom.description: One string per dependency. Format: 'name | version | ecosystem | direct(true/false) | license'. Example: 'express | 4.18.2 | npm | true | MIT'
sbom.title: Sbom

DependencyReportRaw.title: DependencyReportRaw

reachable.description: Whether the vulnerable function is actually called

sufficient.description: Whether sanitization is sufficient to prevent exploit

SecurityContextRaw.description: Flat harness output for security context profiler. All flat, no nesting.

auth_details.description: Brief description of auth implementation details
auth_details.title: Auth Details

auth_model.description: Authentication model: jwt, session_cookie, oauth2, api_key, none, or other
auth_model.title: Auth Model

crypto_usage.description: One string per crypto usage. Format: 'algorithm | key_size | mode | usage_context | is_weak(true/false)'. Example: 'AES | 256 | GCM | data encryption | false'
crypto_usage.title: Crypto Usage

security_signals.description: Framework security features, security headers, and deployment signals. One signal per entry. Examples: 'CSRF protection enabled', 'HSTS header present', 'Runs in Docker'
